name: Chat archive
description: Follows the chat log and copies it somewhere that outlives this machine. One plugin, several backends: postgres today, and a plain file that needs nothing installed.

backend.title: Where to write
backend.description: postgres needs psql on PATH and a dsn. file needs nothing and writes newline-delimited JSON under the polter state directory.

dsn.title: Postgres connection URI
dsn.description: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname -- a credential, so give a reference: env:, file: or keychain:.

stream.title: Which log this is
stream.description: Part of the primary key, so two machines writing to one database do not collide, and so a wiped local log can start over. Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

file_name.title: File to write (file backend)
file_name.description: A bare filename, no directories. It is written under $XDG_STATE_HOME/polter/archive/.
